items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Use one Unicode tokenizer for both re-plan checks**

With the checked jq 1.7/Python 3.14 pair, the two implementations do not actually share a Unicode token grammar: for example, in `specification designᲉ implementation verification`, U+1C89 is a letter to Python, so the gate tokenizes `designᲉ` and rejects the line, while jq's older Unicode table tokenizes `design` and reports `re-plan=present`. An acceptance record containing recently added Unicode letters adjacent to a required word therefore makes the counter claim the merge prerequisite is satisfied while `require-crit-review.py` refuses it; use a shared tokenizer or a version-independent boundary definition.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L78-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/0a84239a0bad3d1335b2ec5b1acfb612faaf422c/AGENTS.md#L78-L78)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
